protocol.llm: existing verified improvements/main/raw/*-first.json; no regeneration or API calls
protocol.cp_score: max over 10 pairs and all canonical shortest-path cells of distance to union of three LLM polylines / (1 + spatial mean prompt dispersion)
protocol.cp_set: free grid cells within qhat * proposal-only dispersion of union of LLM polylines
protocol.cp_guarantee_scope: exchangeable non-demo maps; simultaneous inclusion of the 10 canonical optimal paths per map; no OOD claim; selection biases of original dataset remain
protocol.cp_use: secondary FOCAL priority = distance outside conformal set; never prune by prediction
protocol.chomp: 48 samples; 160 covariant descent steps; analytic obstacle penalty; exact grid revalidation; single standard prompt
protocol.chomp_scope: CHOMP-inspired 2D adaptation, not original CHOMP implementation
protocol.fmm: first-order cardinal upwind Eikonal update; full-grid field; uniform speed control and speed 2 within LLM radius 2
protocol.network: 7 input channels; conv encoder 24/48/64; 2 transformer layers, 4 heads, 128 FFN; convolutional decoder
protocol.transpath_scope: TransPath-inspired learned path-probability + FOCAL, not official pretrained model or exact paper reproduction
protocol.train_labels: all grid cells with d(start,x)+d(x,goal)<=optimal+.5; exact graph distances

training.checkpoint: lowest validation BCE; test never used

protocol.cold_local: cold graph construction + preparation/inference + search; resident warmed neural model; transfer and CUDA synchronization included; one warmup per geometry logged separately
protocol.timing_limits: single execution per case on shared server; hardware load recorded; descriptive latency only, not repeated performance benchmark
protocol.ood: 20 unseen alternating-wall maze maps x 5 queries; only LLM-free methods; no conformal coverage claim
protocol.scaling: first query on first 10 held-out maps at factors 2 and 4; LLM coordinates transformed from cached responses, no new GPT requests
